messages.subject: Item estimation conditioned on known person estimates
parts:
Hi Phil,

Could mirt estimate item parameters only, when person estimates were known and fixed during estimation?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Item estimation conditioned on known person estimates
parts:
In principle yes, but I don't support it (I find it unreasonable to ever assume the latent traits can be obtained without sampling error). Perhaps this thread, combined with an estimator like nlm() (or one from the Rsolnp package) could be useful. Cheers.

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/mirt-package/Federico$20Andreis/mirt-package/OAWxlSwqPzQ/rrxdAn7Xni8J

Phil
